cohort: The cohort consisted of 175 pregnant women identified with fear of birth or depressive symptoms who were offered care in a Midwifery Continuity of Care (MCoC) model.
finding: Both fear of birth and depressive symptoms changed over time, with the highest prevalence during pregnancy and a decline after birth, and these changes may be associated with the intervention.
mod_finding: Fear of birth was associated with mode of birth.
